clauses.en: The wall must carry the screen load; structural checks are by others.

clauses.en: Quantities are subject to site survey and manufacturer detailing.

clauses.zh: 不含土建、市电引入和网络布线。
clauses.en: Civil works, mains supply and network cabling are excluded.
